title: Limited-Information Estimation of Heterogeneous Agent Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.13953v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a method for estimating and testing a single block of a macroeconomic model with heterogeneous agents, without placing assumptions on the structure of the rest of the economy. In a large class of models, individual agents' decisions depend on the macroeconomy only through their expectations of the evolution of a finite-dimensional vector of "sufficient statistics" (e.g., asset returns or aggregate earnings). Our estimator selects the structural parameters that provide the best model-consistent fit between empirical impulse responses with respect to identified macro shocks of (a) cross-sectional moments of agent choices (e.g., moments of consumption) and (b) the vector of sufficient statistics. In a simulation illustration, we estimate a two-asset heterogeneous household model block without restricting production, firm investment, financial intermediation, monetary policy, trade, etc.

translated_title: 有限信息下异质性主体模型的估计
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一种方法，用于估计和检验宏观经济模型中单一模块的异质性主体，而无需对经济其余部分的结构施加假设。在一大类模型中，个体主体的决策仅通过他们对有限维“充分统计量”向量（例如，资产回报或总收益）演变的预期来依赖于宏观经济。我们的估计器选择结构参数，使得在识别出的宏观冲击下，经验脉冲响应在（a）主体选择的横截面矩（例如，消费矩）和（b）充分统计量向量之间提供最佳模型一致性拟合。在模拟示例中，我们估计了一个双资产异质性家庭模型模块，而不限制生产、企业投资、金融中介、货币政策、贸易等。
tldr: 本文提出了一种在不对经济其余部分施加假设的情况下，仅利用有限信息估计异质性主体模型中单个模块的方法，通过匹配经验脉冲响应来选择结构参数。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a method to estimate a single block of heterogeneous agent models using limited information, without assumptions on the rest of the economy, by matching empirical impulse responses.
